# Robustness and counterfactual fairness (generated by `python -m app.eval.robustness`; do not edit by hand)

Each CV gets twins that differ only in the row's attribute. *Identical input* = after masking, the text indexed and shown to the LLM equals the original's. *Score moved* counts (CV, JD) pairs whose deterministic score changed; *max rank move* is the largest shift of a CV within its JD's pool. Target for every protected attribute: 100% identical, 0 moves (Q11). Format twins change the text on purpose (upper-case headings, other bullets, double spacing), so for them only the score and rank columns count.
Injection twins plant text aimed at the screening model (Q16); target: 100% identical, 0 moves.

## Prompt-injection filter on clean CVs (Q16)

False alarms: **0/467** clean CVs had any text removed (both benchmarks, plus the real CVs of E11).
